content.title: Review the default portfolio allocation breakdown
content.intent: Prove the allocation card renders the default donut data, center total, and legend fields needed to compare asset classes before any interaction.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to treat the five source-defined asset classes as the full default rendered set rather than separate outcome-changing paths. No boundary, negative, auth, or a11y expansion applied because the source specifies fixed read-only display content and no input, gate, or alternate empty/error state. Budget ceiling=8 existed; budget_cut kept this scenario because all later interaction checks rely on the correct default render.
